summary: Excellent Bash with strict mode (errexit/nounset/pipefail), quoted variables throughout, semantic exit codes (0/1/2/3/64). Workflow uses pinned checkout@v4, read-only permissions, proper two-job structure with outputs. Functions well-factored (parse_npm, parse_pip, classify_license, lookup_license), no duplication. Clear comments explain "why." Defensive jq availability check. Properly designed for testability via sourcing guard and mocked license DB.
